title: Lifecycle threshold-witness rites
scope: Pattern-level threshold-witness architecture for the four lifecycle rite classes — birth, coming of age, marriage and relationships, death — across the region's three cultures; rite scripts, liturgy, faith content, officiants, calendars, observance detail, marriage-form norms, names and naming language, exchange media, per-culture rite logic, afterlife and Soul fact, protagonist facts, and all natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'A — THRESHOLD-WITNESS' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option A exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
question: Which cross-cutting rite architecture governs what the four lifecycle rite classes — birth, coming of age, marriage and relationships, death — fundamentally do in this region's three cultures at pattern level, without choosing rite scripts, liturgy, deity names, calendar dates, music or costume specifics, funerary-goods inventories, any in-world name or naming language, any marriage-form norm, any afterlife fact or Soul destination, anything owned by the culture-frame, language, or coinage sibling runs, or any new System mechanic, readout guarantee, or CAL0 change?
selection: Use A — THRESHOLD-WITNESS, plus the proposal's shared claim set. Every lifecycle rite is a witnessed crossing: the community formally witnesses a passage and thereby socially ratifies the new state. Birth rites witness acceptance into a household — the crossing is into the hearth, not into existence. Coming-of-age rites witness the culturally interpreted signs of ordinary awakening: they reveal, celebrate, authenticate, teach, and support, and never create, suppress, gate, delay, or own natural access, awakening timing following natural law identically for everyone regardless of ceremony, culture, or omission of ceremony. Marriage rites witness a bond of reciprocal obligation between persons and households. Death rites witness the community's recognition of a death and the reallocation of the dead person's social obligations among the living, establishing nothing about what actually happens to Souls. No rite creates, transfers, or extinguishes assembly standing, property, or tenure; every reallocation is social obligation only; rite failure or omission carries social consequence only; appraisal-adjacent customs are consent-routed disclosure and narrow authenticated proof, never guarantee; birth customs aimed at the unborn carry no mechanical effect; and marriage and relationship forms stay an open qualitative field. Whether a culture stresses who witnesses or what is recorded is illustration only and is not part of the accepted claim, and per-culture rite expression beyond pattern level remains open.
alternatives: A — THRESHOLD-WITNESS: every lifecycle rite is a witnessed crossing in which the community formally witnesses a passage and thereby socially ratifies the new state — birth as acceptance into a household, coming of age at the culturally interpreted signs of ordinary awakening, marriage as a witnessed bond of reciprocal obligation, death as witnessed recognition with reallocation of the dead person's social obligations. Selected.

B — PASSAGE-AND-RETURN: every lifecycle rite frames life as a passage from and toward an unseen continuity — greeting an arrival, confirming full arrival, joining two journeys, sending the person onward — licensing reincarnation-adjacent folk belief strictly as contested belief that no rite or sign confirms. Not selected.

C — NAME-AND-RECORD: every lifecycle rite turns on names and standing as social practice only — provisional name and household standing at birth, full name and full social standing at the recognised awakening stage, standings merged or linked by marriage, and the name invoked by the living after death. Not selected.
rationale: The selected architecture deepens what canon already runs on: the compact's grammar of oath, witness, and sworn testimony extends naturally to household scale, and witnessing is the rite element that adapts most readily to whatever societal structure each culture-frame run gives its culture. It also keeps belief-space maximally open — passage cosmologies and ancestor-name practices can still appear later as household or strand beliefs — whereas the alternatives each spend more of the open belief and naming space at architecture level.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-17: 'A — THRESHOLD-WITNESS' chosen from the displayed multiple-choice options, with the proposal's shared claim set.
consequences: In all three cultures — original, imperial-remnant, and hybrid settlement — every lifecycle rite is a witnessed crossing that socially ratifies the new state, and each culture times and staffs its rites by its own custom, none fixed.
All three cultures possess all four rite classes — birth, coming of age, marriage and relationships, death — each internally varied in keeping them.
Birth rites witness acceptance into a household: the crossing is into the hearth, not into existence.

Coming-of-age rites witness the culturally interpreted signs of ordinary awakening; ceremony wraps natural awakening and never modifies, causes, gates, or delays it, and awakening timing follows natural law identically for everyone regardless of ceremony, culture, or omission of ceremony.
Marriage rites witness a bond of reciprocal obligation between persons and households.

Death rites witness the community's recognition of a death and the reallocation of the dead person's social obligations among the living, and establish nothing about what actually happens to Souls; afterlife, reincarnation, and ancestor content is contested belief.

Rites are socially binding only: none triggers, gates, delays, guarantees, or owns any System event, and none creates, transfers, or extinguishes assembly standing, property, or tenure — every reallocation, marriage's inherited-duty obligation class included, is social obligation only.
Rite failure or omission carries social consequence only.

Birth customs aimed at the unborn are belief with no mechanical effect on the child's progression, and no ordinary person has prenatal System access, practice, or continuity; the series contract's WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint and no project default is adopted into the setting.

Appraisal-adjacent customs, marriage-negotiation disclosure included, route only through consent, voluntary disclosure, and narrow authenticated proof — custom, never guarantee — with uneven and often unavailable access, so such customs are aspirational, elite, or specialist-mediated in distributions left open.

Marriage and relationship forms remain an open qualitative field in every culture: household-formation logics and obligation classes only, no numeric norm, and plural versus monogamous variety stays explicitly varied and open.
Whatever rite practice the hybrid settlement keeps, it echoes no office and claims no governance power.

Declared qualitative closure of the awakening, coming-of-age, and guardianship-custom space WLD-CULTURE-001 left open: the four rite classes exist in all three cultures under the witnessed-crossing architecture, and all observance content remains open.

Whether a culture stresses who witnesses or what is recorded is illustration only and is not established; the culture-frame records each remain free to give their own culture a different rite logic, and the settlement-founding record alone owns the settlement's founding frame.

The language and exchange-media records stay untouched: attestation fixes no script, literacy, speech variety, naming language, or record medium, and rite obligations fix and exclude no exchange medium, valuation, or monetary custom.

Witness, crossing, acceptance, attestation, record, and standing are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, language, rite script, liturgy, calendar, office, law, institution, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.
No quantitative claim of any kind is established: no age, count, proportion, demography, price, measurement, date, or calendar, and WLD-RARITY-001D's deferral of universal proportions stands.
No new System mechanic, readout guarantee, CAL0 change, project-default adoption, parked-species or returning-peoples development, protagonist fact, plot event, or occurred ceremony is created.
residual_unknowns: All observance content — scripts, seasons, officiants, costume, music, foodways, and each culture's actual rite repertoires, including whether rite occasions fall inside festival seasons at all — remains open.
Each culture's own rite logic under the chosen architecture remains open; the per-culture emphases are illustrative only and the culture-frame records may each answer differently.
Faith content behind the rites — deities, cosmologies, and which passage or ancestor beliefs which households actually hold — remains open.
Guardianship custom around pre-awakening children and pending entitlements remains open.
Marriage-form distribution — which household-formation logics and obligation classes predominate where, and their politics — remains open.
Whether any funeral practice has real causal effect beyond symbol remains open and deliberately unclaimed.
Record media, literacy, and naming logic, and exchange customs inside rite obligations, remain open in their owning records.
The outlet settlement's internal rite variety and minority practices remain open.
How rites meet the approaching first succession — a successor's coming of age, marriage, or funeral politics — remains open to story evidence only.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted culture-frame work cannot give any of the three cultures a rite logic expressible as witnessed crossings.
Later accepted governance or tenure work requires a rite to create, transfer, or extinguish assembly standing, property, or tenure.
Later accepted System work requires ceremony to cause, gate, or delay awakening, or requires a guaranteed appraisal readout inside a rite custom.
Later accepted continuity work requires death rites to establish what actually happens to Souls.
The Author explicitly chooses another rite architecture.
